name: Starlink Group 15-20
slot_a_text: B1100 has flown nine times over 9 months. All but 1 flight were Starlink missions. Its quickest turnaround was 23 days.
slot_b_text: Low Earth orbit is anywhere from about 160 to 2,000 km up, where a satellite laps the planet roughly every 90 minutes. Everything there is falling; it just keeps missing the ground.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
